handoff: The T33 debug menu (backtick key, debug builds only) now has Control sections. Events: frequency (event_interval), price multiplier (event_price_pct), price and closure cycles, a checkbox list to keep events out of the random pick (runtime only, events.debug_off), and the existing fire-event trigger. Routes: ship_cap spin, a per-route dump of ship, level and orders, clear route orders, clear local orders, plus the existing set-level. Save button writes live values and targets to data/balance.json, other keys kept and whole numbers written as ints, so an untouched save leaves the file byte-identical (tested). Try it: run game, press backtick, scroll to Control. Gated by debug_tools_allowed / OS.is_debug_build. Tests: 0 fail.
